jobs.title: Lead Airport Security Officer | TSA Leadership & Training
jobs.description:
Airport Security Careers seeks Lead and Supervisory Transportation Security Officers for Richardson-area airports. These leadership roles oversee screening teams, ensure TSA compliance, and train and mentor officers.

Starting pay is $25.00–$50.00 per hour with annual pay of $52,000–$80,000+. Benefits include PTO, health/dental/vision/life insurance, a federal retirement plan with TSP, overtime, and career growth opportunities.
